preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 500 for x in stdin.split())
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two integers r and c, each between 1 and 500 inclusive.
Input contains exactly two space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '0' if (r + c) > 10**9 else any(all(1 <= int(y) <= 10**9 for y in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If no diverse matrix exists (i.e., when r + c > 10**9 or r == 1 and c == 1), output is '0'. Otherwise, output is an r × c matrix where each element is a positive integer ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == c for line in stdout.splitlines()) if stdout.strip() != '0' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not '0', it consists of exactly r lines, each containing exactly c space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '0') and (len(stdout.splitlines()) == r) and (all(1 <= int(y) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines() for y in line.split()))
postconditions.description: If output is not '0', it is a valid r × c matrix with positive integers ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '0') and (len(set(b)) == r + c) and (max(b) == min(max(b) for b in [compute_row_gcds(stdout), compute_col_gcds(stdout)]))
postconditions.description: If output is not '0', the matrix is diverse (all row and column GCDs are distinct) and its magnitude is minimized. Here, b is the concatenation of row GCDs and column GCDs, and compute_row_gcds/stdout computes GCDs for each row/column.
